title: Notes from closing 80+ product issues
author: Nguyễn Quốc Huy
excerpt: Debugging notes from UI state, product logic, and crash-prone flows.
content: I start by reproducing the issue and tracing the user action through UI state, API response, and side effects.
The fix is usually smaller after the real state owner is clear.
Frontend quality depends on predictable async flows, explicit failure states, and changes that do not break existing behavior.

title: Realtime UI needs clear state ownership
author: Nguyễn Quốc Huy
excerpt: Lessons from like/comment sync, realtime location, notifications, and chat state.
content: Realtime UI needs one source of truth so socket events, API responses, and optimistic updates stay consistent.
Redux Toolkit helped keep conversation and interaction state predictable when events arrived in different orders.
Mobile notifications should confirm useful state changes without adding noise.

title: Frontend work improves with backend context
author: Nguyễn Quốc Huy
excerpt: How API contracts, data shape, auth, storage, and payment affect product UI.
content: Frontend decisions are better when API contracts, data shape, and failure cases are understood early.
Event Flow and JinStore connected UI flows with authentication, payment, storage, and database decisions.
My current focus is frontend reliability with enough backend context to own complete features.
